newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Anglo units to expand Zambian milling firm.
newsitem.headline: Anglo units to expand Zambian milling firm.

text.p: Anglo American Corp of South Africa units Erabas BV and Namib Milling will spend $12.2 million to expand Zambia's largest milling company, which they acquired under a privatisation programme, the Investment Centre said on Tesday.
"National Milling is to undergo a major expansion and modernisation exercise following an injection of $12.2 million by its new owners," the Investment Centre said in a statement.
The expansion and modernisation programme was expected to take at least three years, the spokesman added.

Erabus BV and Namib Milling bought the government's 51 percent stake in National Milling for $400,000, bringing their total shareholding to 100 percent. They also took over the company's liabilities of $10.6 million.
